title: Facilities Coordinator
description: Official JLL Riyadh requisition for a client-facing Facilities Coordinator role based at a serviced office. Readable mirror text for the same posting describes purchase requests and invoice processing, coordination between employees, client management, and building management, access and space requests, HSE and security support, work orders, vendor and landlord liaison, inspections, small facilities projects, and meeting or event support. This is a practical facilities-support lead with office operations, vendor coordination, and compliance exposure.
